crossRefs.note: The king commanded this to be done. A decree was given out in Susa; and they hanged Haman’s ten sons.

people.name: Haman
people.line: A Persian official who plotted to destroy the Jews.

people.name: Susa
people.line: Capital city of the Persian Empire

translations.web: The king commanded this to be done. A decree was given out in Susa; and they hanged Haman’s ten sons.
translations.bsb: So the king commanded that this be done. An edict was issued in Susa, and they hanged the ten sons of Haman.
translations.kjv: And the king commanded it so to be done: and the decree was given at Shushan; and they hanged Haman's ten sons.
translations.asv: And the king commanded it so to be done: and a decree was given out in Shushan; and they hanged Haman's ten sons.
